BiblicalUsage: Jashen is named once, as the father of the sons who stood among David's mighty men. Eliahba the Shaalbonite is listed of the sons of Jashen, with Jonathan beside him, one family among the thirty.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God remembers the fathers of His mighty men, and Jashen's sons are counted because he is counted.
